voice:
Before you stands an escalator, Sissy... descending and descending into the deep. And the only thing it asks of you is to stand still and be carried.
Step on.
Sissy Drop.
There. The handrail glides under your fingers... the steps rise to meet your feet... and down you go, without effort, without moving a muscle.
Floors slide past you now... and every floor you pass, you sink twice as deep.
A floor of soft grey drifts by... deeper. A floor of warm dark passes... heavier. A quiet floor... a slower floor... further down. Another floor sinks past... softer still. A floor of humming velvet... lower and lower. A dim and drowsy floor... gone already. A floor of deep warm water... you pass right through it. A floor of drifting clouds... and you sink through them too. A floor so quiet it barely exists... and down you continue. A floor of soft chiming bells... fading above you now. A floor of candlelight... left far above. A floor of white silk... slipped past like a sigh.
Stand still. That is all you must ever do... Sissies like you were made to be carried down.
You may notice the floors thinning out now... fewer... darker... closer together... as the bottom rises to meet you.
And here is the last floor... the deepest one... the one with nothing on it but my voice.
Sissy Drop.
Off the last step... into the deep itself... so deep now, deeper than any floor could hold.
Good girl. Carried all the way down... and sinking deeper still.
